summary.plain: The LHAASO cosmic-ray and gamma-ray observatory on Haizi Mountain, Daocheng County, Sichuan, China.
summary.technical: One local map for facility:lhaaso-daocheng. Drawn as a single approximate reference point; KM2A (circular, ~575-635 m radius) and WCDA (78,000 m2, three pools) are described with enough shape detail to draw but could not be anchored to a precise-enough coordinate this session (see geometry record and worklog backlog).
